tool.name: Example Notes AI
tool.one_line_capability: Turns several meeting notes into a one-page summary

audience: A project manager who runs a weekly team meeting
task: Prepare a one-page meeting brief: past decisions, open action items, and owners
before_steps: Open five old notes one by one
Copy each decision and action item
Compare by hand to find gaps
friction: Items are scattered across five notes, so unowned follow-ups slip through
ai_change: The AI reads the same notes and drafts the brief first
after_steps: Check dates and owners against the originals
human_check: Confirm open items such as the vendor quote have the right date and owner
next_action: Try it on one non-sensitive old note and compare with a manual summary
narration: Thursday's project meeting. Five old notes! What did we decide, and what's still open? Before, you'd open each note, copy every item, and compare them by hand. Easy to miss one. Now? You upload the same five notes to Example Notes AI. And boom, it drafts a one-page prep brief: decisions, open action items, and owners. Like this one: vendor quote, no reply yet, owner Maya. But it's a draft. Before you send it, check each date and owner against the original notes. If you run weekly meetings, try it on one old, non-sensitive note first, and see what it misses.

existing.shows: Feature tour of summaries for a sales team, no human check

coverage.our_angle: A project manager preps one weekly meeting brief and checks owners and dates before sending
